saw_lines: Shoppers buy pantry staples like ghee and heeng by habit, switching only when a brand earns trust on the first purchase.
So the sale is won or lost at the first order, when a new buyer decides whether to try this brand.
Your site offers 5% off up to ₹100 on prepaid orders, 2 of 24 ads mention any offer. Open three new ads with the prepaid offer on the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Your site offers 5% off up to ₹100 on prepaid orders, yet only 2 of 24 ads mention any offer, so a first time buyer has no reason to act. Open three new ads with the prepaid offer on the creative.

Your site shows 6,00,000+ Families and 3223 Reviews, but only 11 of 29 ads carry the families number, so cold viewers see less proof than the homepage. Put the families line on every creative, then test one review count against it.
Six of your 24 copy ads are creator posts run from the brand page. Buyers can’t tell who is speaking. Whitelist those six from the creator accounts, then cut three variations of the best one.

Your 24 copy ads open 18 different ways, and the biggest opener, the Himalayan salts story, leads only 3 of them. Each new opening starts from zero. Pick the two strongest openings and make the next batch from them.

ads_1: Two strongest openers rebuilt around the 5% prepaid offer, three new variations
